areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Product promoting nature-based solutions and urban climate adaptation, aligned with resilient-city concepts.

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: Expands sanitation in priority sub-basins, including sewage connection, plus detention basins and flood-control reservoirs.

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
areas.reason: Environmental requalification of watercourses, renaturalized channels and spring protection and recovery.

areas.name: Biodiversity and forest resources
areas.reason: Protected areas, conservation of riparian preservation areas and linear parks around reservoirs.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Resettlement of vulnerable families from risk areas into housing improving sanitary and living conditions.

areas.name: Technological development, innovation and modernization
areas.reason: Institutional strengthening upgrades the hydrological monitoring and flood-alert system, with data modeling and a flood-forecasting system.
